# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀彙總 node 目錄中的 mailtodo 信件；不修復或修改輸入。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo <folder> --now 2026-10-09T19:00:00+00:00
```

成功時 stdout 只有一行 JSON。`--now` 必須是帶時區、可由 `datetime.fromisoformat` 解析的時間；缺少參數、時間無效或輸入不是目錄時，退出碼為 2 且 stdout 為空。工具不讀系統時鐘；信件中未帶時區的 `at` 使用 `--now` 的時區。

只檢查各非隱藏 mailbox 的 `inbox/*.md` 與 `inbox/done/*.md`，不跟隨符號連結，也不遞迴。輸出包含 `v`、`open`、`boxes`、`bad`；無效信件只列入 `bad`，不參與計數或回覆判定。

測試與獨立核對：

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture
```

files.packs/mailtodo/tests/test_mailtodo.py:
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T13:00:00+00:00"


def put(root, relative, fields=None, text=None):
    path = root / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if text is None:
        text = "---\n" + "\n".join(f"{key}: {value}" for key, value in fields.items()) + "\n---\nbody\n"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def run(root, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(root), *args],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_open_reply_counts_and_empty_box(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1200-one.md",
                {"id": "a", "from": "alice", "to": "bob", "status": "REQUEST", "at": "2026-10-09T12:00:00"})
            put(root, "bob/inbox/20261009T1201-two.md",
                {"id": "b", "from": "bob", "to": "alice", "status": "REQUEST", "at": "2026-10-09T12:01:00+00:00"})
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1202-progress.md",
                {"id": "p", "from": "alice", "to": "bob", "status": "PROGRESS", "at": NOW, "re": "b"})
            put(root, "bob/inbox/done/20261009T1203-reply.md",
                {"id": "r", "from": "bob", "to": "alice", "status": "DONE", "at": NOW, "re": "a"})
            put(root, "alice/inbox/done/20261009T1204-archive.md",
                {"id": "archive", "from": "alice", "to": "bob", "status": "FAILED", "at": NOW, "re": " "})
            (root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {
                "v": 1,
                "open": [{"id": "b", "from": "bob", "to": "alice", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 59}],
                "boxes": {"alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1, "PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 1},
                          "bob": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 1},
                          "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}},
                "bad": []})

    def test_invalid_precedence_duplicates_and_ignored_paths(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            base = {"id": "shared", "from": "a", "to": "b", "status": "REQUEST", "at": NOW}
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1200-first.md", base)
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1201-second.md", base)
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1202-no-front.md", text="not frontmatter\n")
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1203-no-id.md",
                {"id": "", "from": "a", "to": "b", "status": "DONE", "at": NOW})
            put(root, "box/inbox/20260230T1200-bad-date.md", base)
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1204-bad-at.md",
                {**base, "at": "invalid"})
            put(root, "box/inbox/.ignored.md", text="invalid")
            put(root, "box/inbox/nested/20261009T1200-ignored.md", text="invalid")
            put(root, "box/inbox/done/.ignored.md", text="invalid")
            put(root, ".hidden/inbox/20261009T1200-ignored.md", text="invalid")
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {"box": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0}})
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [{"id": "shared", "from": "a", "to": "b",
                                             "where": "inbox", "age_min": 0}])
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [
                {"file": "box/inbox/20260230T1200-bad-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1201-second.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1202-no-front.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1203-no-id.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1204-bad-at.md", "why": "no_field"}])

    def test_exit_codes_negative_age_and_unchanged_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            path = put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1301-next.md",
                       {"id": "next", "from": "a", "to": "b", "status": "REQUEST",
                        "at": "2026-10-09T13:01:00"})
            before = (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mode, path.stat().st_size,
                      path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
            good = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(good.returncode, 0, good.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(good.stdout)["open"][0]["age_min"], -1)
            self.assertEqual(before, (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mode,
                                      path.stat().st_size, path.stat().st_mtime_ns))
            for folder, options in ((root, ()), (root, ("--now", "invalid")),
                                    (root, ("--now", "2026-10-09T13:00:00")),
                                    (path, ("--now", NOW)),
                                    (root / "absent", ("--now", NOW))):
                with self.subTest(folder=folder, options=options):
                    result = run(folder, *options)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

    def test_duplicate_keys_and_reply_requires_valid_letter(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            put(root, "box/inbox/20261009T1200-request.md", text=(
                "---\nid: old\nid: latest\nfrom: a\nto: b\nstatus: REQUEST\n"
                "at: 2026-10-09T12:00:00+00:00\n---\n"))
            put(root, "box/inbox/done/20261009T1201-invalid.md",
                {"id": "bad", "from": "b", "to": "a", "status": "DONE",
                 "at": "invalid", "re": "latest"})
            put(root, "box/inbox/done/20261009T1202-progress.md",
                {"id": "p", "from": "b", "to": "a", "status": "PROGRESS",
                 "at": NOW, "re": "latest"})
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [{"id": "latest", "from": "a", "to": "b",
                                             "where": "inbox", "age_min": 60}])
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"]["box"], {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 1})
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [
                {"file": "box/inbox/done/20261009T1201-invalid.md", "why": "no_field"}])
